about.purpose: Process local drone TIFF or HDF5 inputs through correction, extraction, optional affine translation, and QA.
about.path_rule: Relative paths are resolved from the repository root.
about.input_rule: The input may be one HDF5 or TIFF input or a directory searched recursively for supported drone inputs. Production translation uses the packaged, reviewed site-balanced registry; an explicit registry path may override it.
